slices.focus: Formal presentation saves boot camp and check-in system for another full cycle; Derek becomes recognized point person
slices.summary: Derek compiles foreman emails, apprentice practical scores, and repeat write-up data into a formal presentation that earns cautious approval to continue the boot camp and first-year check-in system for another full cycle. He is now internally recognized as the point person for first-year retention and safety at IBEW Local 5 and the JATC. He decides to build a lean one-page summary plus backup packet strategy for future reviews, protect three non-negotiables (hands-on boot camp, pattern-based check-ins, contractor-connected tracking), and set a fixed mid-cycle review cadence so he is not always playing defense.
open_loops: Starting a simple call log documenting foreman requests for track graduates
Writing a one-page summary of non-negotiables as program standards (not personal preferences)
Setting mid-cycle review dates and metrics (practical scores, safety write-ups, field comments)
Building a repeatable review packet format for future cycles
decisions: IBEW Local 5 and the training committee now recognize Derek internally as the point person for the continuing first-year
